intent: Inspect and refactor application.yml without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Externalized configuration file src/main/resources/application.yml: telemetry.* keys binding TelemetryProperties (boundaries HEART_RATE 30-240, POWER 0-2500, CADENCE 0-220, SWIM_PACE min 45 minExclusive with large max; reorder-window PT60S; flush-interval; event-buffer-capacity; overflow-strategy; late-packet-policy APPEND_REVISION; retry-max-attempts; retry-backoff; dead-letter-capacity), spring.r2dbc.url/credentials from env with H2 (r2dbc:h2:mem) default for tests, spring.flyway.* JDBC url, actuator exposure.
